description: This file implements GTP-U gateway classes and session management for UDP connections, including specific classes for remote and local UPF scenarios, with functions to create these gateways.

classes.name: udp_ngu_tnl_session
classes.description: Implementation of a NG-U TNL PDU session using UDP, handling PDU forwarding and data notification.

classes.name: udp_ngu_gateway
classes.description: Implementation of NG-U gateway for remote UDP connection, creating UDP TNL sessions.

classes.name: no_core_ngu_tnl_pdu_session
classes.description: Stub implementation of NG-U TNL PDU session for local UPF, with no actual PDU handling.

classes.name: no_core_ngu_gateway
classes.description: Stub implementation of NG-U gateway for local UPF, creating no-op TNL sessions.

methods.name: create_udp_gtpu_gateway
methods.description: Factory function to create a UDP-based NG-U GTP-U gateway with specified configuration and executors.

methods.name: create_no_core_gtpu_gateway
methods.description: Factory function to create a stub NG-U GTP-U gateway for local UPF scenario.
